    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.121.19...0.121.20">0.121.20</a> (2026-07-30)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add Claude Opus 5 support (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10210" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10210/hovercard">#10210</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/ff84f13605c09cac0c3c591d9590622f864cc2f7">ff84f13</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add current Azure, Claude, and Gemini models (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10128" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10128/hovercard">#10128</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/5c216a1bc33104bb507a9e57952b81a0fb27d06f">5c216a1</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add Kimi K3 support to Moonshot provider (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10132" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10132/hovercard">#10132</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/a1168b62ef31a6c061f16ecdf2bfd76514e2a852">a1168b6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>websocket:</strong> support URL templating (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10171" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10171/hovercard">#10171</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/a9aacede5c3f84150d999bfbeadbbf39834370ea">a9aaced</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> default conversation-relevance threshold to 0.5 (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10142" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10142/hovercard">#10142</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/2812d7622b2e14f59753ac04e28b1ca63257263b">2812d76</a>)</li>
<li><strong>azure:</strong> avoid crash on empty completion choices (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10124" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10124/hovercard">#10124</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/17d8d036420a63e4a9205084f096b82591b3b608">17d8d03</a>)</li>
